TEAM RELAY 台風の目

Typhoon Race

Five players, one long pole. Spin around cone 1, U-turn at cone 2, sweep the pole under your team’s feet and over their heads, then pass it on.

  • 3 teams
  • 5 per group
  • 1 long pole

Watch one round

0:00 – 0:38

The first 38 seconds show one full round. Your team keeps going until every group has run.

How to play

Tap a card to play or pause its animation.

    Whole course

    Top view
    WAITING START CONE 1 CONE 2 · U-TURN

      NOW

      1×

      Rules

      Teams and lanes

      All 3 teams run a continuous relay at the same time, one lane per team. Waiting groups stand in rows, one group per row. The front row goes next.

      Dropped the pole?

      If the pole falls or someone lets go, grab it again and keep going. No penalty.

      Missed a jump or duck?

      If the pole hits a waiting teammate who didn’t jump or duck, there’s no penalty. Keep going.

      Finish

      The relay ends when every group on your team has run. Teams are ranked by the order they finish.

      Points

      1. 1st50 pts
      2. 2nd40 pts
      3. 3rd20 pts

      Up to 8. Eight groups means all 40 players run.

      TEAM THROW 玉入れ

      Beanbag Toss

      Ten players, one basket, two minutes. Throw as many balls into your team’s basket as you can before the end signal.

      • 3 teams
      • 10 per match
      • 4 matches
      • 100 balls each

      Watch a clip

          1×

          Rules

          Teams & matches

          • 4 matches, 2 min each
          • All 3 teams throw at once
          • 10 players per team, each match
          • Players picked on game day. Everyone plays once.

          Balls

          • 100 balls per team
          • They start on the circle line
          • Pick up, throw, repeat
          • Any ball color is fine

          The circle

          • 5 m circle around the basket
          • Never step inside. Throw from outside.
          • Volunteers inside throw fallen balls back to you
          • Stepped in? Go back out.

          What counts

          • Whistle starts and ends the match
          • Only balls in the basket count
          • Thrown after the end? Doesn’t count.

          Points

          Balls from all 4 matches are added up.

          1. 1st50 pts
          2. 2nd40 pts
          3. 3rd20 pts

          If totals are tied

          Extra round
          Tied teams play 1 more round of 1 minute. Each team leader picks 10 players.
          Still tied?
          Play again.

          TEAM RELAY ムカデ競争

          Centipede Race

          Four players, two planks. Walk in step to the next handoff point. All six groups go in the same direction, and the team whose 6th group crosses the finish line first wins.

          • 3 teams
          • 4 per group
          • 6 groups
          • 2 planks

              1×

              Rules

              Teams & groups

              • All 3 teams race at once, one lane each
              • 4 players per group
              • 6 groups per team, so 24 of 40 players run
              • Group order is decided on the spot

              Planks

              • 2 planks per team
              • One foot on each plank
              • No cones and no long pole

              The relay

              • All six groups walk in the same direction
              • Same distance for every group
              • Hand the planks over at the next handoff point. Group 6 crosses the finish line.

              Fell off?

              • Put the planks back on
              • Carry on from the same spot
              • No penalty

              Points

              Ranked by finish order: the team whose 6th group finishes first wins. No stopwatch.

              1. 1st50 pts
              2. 2nd40 pts
              3. 3rd20 pts

              BRANCH TAG

              Dondarm Slerk Cher

              When your number is called, run into the circle. Grab the branch and carry it to the edge before an opponent tags you.

              • 3 teams
              • 2 × 10 players per team
              • 7 m radius
              • 90 s per round

              Watch a round

              Coming soon

              Video coming soon

              How to play

              Tap a card to play or pause its animation.

                The circle

                Top view

                  NOW

                  Small squares are waiting players. Their positions are illustrative. The timeout example is sped up.

                  1×

                  Rules

                  Teams & groups

                  • White Team, Red Team, and Blue Team
                  • 2 groups of 10 per team. One group from each team plays at a time.
                  • Line up side by side near the edge.
                  • 10 rounds per group, one scheduled per player.

                  Calling numbers

                  • Number players 1–10. Round 1 starts with number 1.
                  • Call the other numbers in random order.
                  • On each call, one player with that number enters per team.
                  • Stalemate? The game master may call extra numbers one at a time to help retrieve the branch.

                  Taking the branch

                  • First to grab the branch in the center holds it.
                  • Stealing is allowed. Grab it together? Tug or let go.
                  • Anyone touching the branch can be tagged.
                  • Block opponents to shield teammates.
                  • No pushing or tackling anyone.

                  Winning a round

                  • 7 m radius. The circle’s edge is the goal.
                  • Carry the branch to the edge to win.
                  • Tag the carrier before they reach the edge. Your team wins.
                  • Only one team can win. No winner if the 90-second clock runs out.

                  Points

                  Record each win and its time. Rank teams by total wins. The MC announces the totals at the end.

                  1. 1st50 pts
                  2. 2nd40 pts
                  3. 3rd20 pts

                  Tiebreaker. If wins are tied, each team picks one player for a final round.
